name: flow
label: Steps that pass something along: a line, a checklist column, or a loop that never stops

variant.label: line = 2 or 3 nodes across, column = rows that tick, loop = laps that speed up while a counter climbs

nodes.label: Node labels, | separated (2 to 4, line at most 3)

images.label: Optional node images, | separated, same order (blank = the step number)

carrier.label: The thing that travels: a short text

go_at.label: line and column: when the carrier leaves each node, | separated

count_label.label: loop: what it counts, 1 or 2 words

stop_at.label: loop: when it stops dead (blank = end)

out.label: cut = hold to the end, edge = leave
